description: This Java interface defines the structure for responses related to 'ThingCommand' operations in the Eclipse Ditto framework, including method signatures, constants, and nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: ThingCommandResponse
classes.description: A generic interface representing responses associated with Thing commands, parameterized to allow different response types, extending CommandResponse and WithThingId.

classes.name: ThingCommandResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains static definitions for JSON fields used within the ThingCommandResponse, specifically the 'thingId' field.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response; defaults to getThingEntityId().

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'things'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for this response.
